breeds.name: Labrador Retriever
breeds.description: Outgoing and eager to please, Labradors need real daily exercise and thrive in a family setting with a yard.

breeds.name: French Bulldog
breeds.description: A compact companion that does well in apartments. Short walks are enough, but the breed is sensitive to heat.

breeds.name: Border Collie
breeds.description: Highly intelligent and driven. Without a job or serious daily activity this breed becomes restless.

breeds.name: Shiba Inu
breeds.description: Cat-like and self-possessed. Clean and quiet indoors, but strong-willed and best suited to an experienced owner.

breeds.name: Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
breeds.description: Gentle and people-focused, bred purely as a companion. Happiest when included in everything the household does.

breeds.name: German Shepherd
breeds.description: Confident and highly trainable, with strong guarding instincts. Needs space, structure, and consistent early socialisation.

breeds.name: Domestic Shorthair
breeds.description: The mixed-ancestry house cat. Temperament varies widely by individual, but most adapt easily to indoor life.

breeds.name: Maine Coon
breeds.description: A large, sociable cat often described as dog-like. The long coat needs regular brushing to avoid matting.

breeds.name: Siamese
breeds.description: Vocal and intensely social. This breed does poorly when left alone for long stretches of the day.

breeds.name: British Shorthair
breeds.description: Easygoing and undemanding, content to keep you company without constant attention. Prone to weight gain.

breeds.name: Bengal
breeds.description: Athletic and endlessly curious. Needs climbing space and interactive play or it will find its own entertainment.

breeds.name: Ragdoll
breeds.description: Unusually relaxed about being handled. Quiet and slow to warm up to new people, but very attached once settled.
